instruction: Cinematic medium shot of a man in a brown shirt and tan beanie (R1) and a woman in a black dress (R2) posing together against a draped, reflective silver fabric backdrop. The man (R1) stands on the left in profile, facing left with his arms extended forward. The woman (R2) stands close behind him on the right, wrapping her left arm over his shoulder and chest. Soft, diffused lighting highlights the cool metallic background, contrasting with the warm tones of the man's brown shirt and the woman's dark dress, creating a focused, artistic atmosphere.
